operations.lua:
local c = nil
for _, city in Players[0]:GetCities():Members() do
  if Locale.Lookup(city:GetName()) == "Gongju" then c = city end
end
if c == nil then print("ERR|Gongju missing") return end
local info = GameInfo.Buildings["BUILDING_GRANARY"]
local cb = c:GetBuildings()
if not cb:HasBuilding(info.Index) then print("ERR|Gongju has no granary to remove") return end
if cb.RemoveBuilding == nil then
  print("ERR|CityBuildings:RemoveBuilding is not available in GameCore") return
end
cb:RemoveBuilding(info.Index)
print("OK|removed|Gongju|BUILDING_GRANARY")
operations.readback_lua:
local minimum_surplus = 1
local c = nil
for _, city in Players[0]:GetCities():Members() do
  if Locale.Lookup(city:GetName()) == "Gongju" then c = city end
end
if c == nil then print("ERR|Gongju missing") return end
local info = GameInfo.Buildings["BUILDING_GRANARY"]
local gain = info.Housing or 0
local surplus = c:GetGrowth():GetHousing() - c:GetPopulation()
local granary = c:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(info.Index)
if not granary and surplus < minimum_surplus and surplus + gain >= minimum_surplus then
  print("OK|housing_city|Gongju|surplus " .. surplus .. "|granary_housing " .. gain)
else
  print("ERR|Gongju surplus " .. surplus .. " granary_housing " .. gain
        .. " has_granary " .. tostring(granary))
end
